about: Motorcycle bays from councils, merged into uk-bays.json by scripts/fetch_uk_bays.py. A bay OpenStreetMap already has (within 25 m) keeps its OpenStreetMap id and position and takes the council's details; the rest are added. Hillingdon and Bromley positions were placed from descriptions using OpenStreetMap addresses and junctions ('approximate' marks those placed from a nearby address); Islington and Camden supplied coordinates. Fee defaults to 'free', marked unconfirmed unless the source's feeConfirmed is true. 'note' says where to look; 'rules' says when it is charged and how to pay.

hillingdon.name: Hillingdon Council traffic orders (FOI 06397)
hillingdon.confirmation: Hillingdon Council confirmed in its follow-up to FOI 06397 (November 2026) that no parking charges or permits apply to any designated on-street motorcycle parking place in the borough, and that it holds no record of how many motorcycles each place holds.

bromley.name: Bromley Council motorcycle parking page
bromley.confirmation: bromley.gov.uk/parking/motorcycle-parking (read November 2026): 'A number of free marked parking bays are available exclusively for motor scooter, moped and motorcycle riders.' Space counts are given for the town centre bays only.

islington.name: Islington Council motorcycle bay list (FOI 8652875)
islington.confirmation: Islington Council's response to FOI 8652875 (November 2026): a list of solo motorcycle bays with coordinates, spaces, parking times, charged times, RingGo location and controlled zone.

camden.name: Camden Council Parking Bays open data (Open Government Licence v3.0)
camden.confirmation: Camden's Parking Bays dataset on opendata.camden.gov.uk, downloaded 13 November 2026: restriction type, times of operation, tariff, cashless location, zone, bay length and coordinates for each bay. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
